name: forge-agents
description: Wires bots and coding agents into GitLab, GitHub and Forgejo or Gitea safely: the identity and token a CI or bot agent needs, label and assignment triggers, signed and deduplicated webhook listeners, untrusted text written through the API without quick actions or mentions, retries that never duplicate a creating POST, Claude Code in GitLab CI, and headless agents on repos you do not control.
